task.question: How many years was it since DR Congo last appeared in the FIFA World Cup before their knockout stage match against England on July 1, 2026?
task.evidence: Although DR Congo were eliminated, this marked their best-ever finish in the FIFA World Cup upon their return after 52 years.

answer:
DR Congo last appeared in the FIFA World Cup in 1974. The knockout stage match against England is scheduled for July 1, 2026. 

To find out how many years it was since their last appearance in 1974 until 2026, we calculate:

2026 - 1974 = 52 years

FINAL: 52
